               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4065">grags she ba</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P1303 11th abbot of Snar thang"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">dpal_ldan mchims </rs><?oxy_comment_start comment="P1298 12th abbot of Snar thang"?><?oxy_comment_end?>|

               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8252">spang ston grub pa shes rab</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P1302 14th abbot of Snar thang"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               dpal_ldan bla ma chos kyi spyan ldan <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:"><!--probably id:4551-->ku mA ra shri</rs> <pb n="204a"/><lb n="204a1"/> de la  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4115">bdag</rs> gis bka' drin zhus_so || ||   
               
               yang  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5839">bla ma rin po che 'gos lo tsA ba</rs>P318| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8395">spyan snga rin po che chos kyi brags pa ye shes dpal bzang po {</rs>P317}| 
               de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">bdag</rs> gis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">bla ma chen po</rs>'i <rs type="work">TIka</rs> chen gyi stengs<anchor xml:id="a2"/> nas tshar gcig bka' drin mngos <lb n="204a2"/> so || 
               
               yang na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo chen po</rs>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">dge bshes ston pa</rs>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6689">dgon pa ba {</rs>P1322 1016-1082} | 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3825">sne'u zur pa<anchor xml:id="a3"/></rs>| <lb n="204a3"/>
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8396">rgyang ro dar brtson<anchor xml:id="a4"/></rs>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8321">lji pa ston grags</rs>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7537">spyi lhas pa byang chub 'od</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P0RK647"?><?oxy_comment_end?><anchor xml:id="a5"/>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8354">grang bu lung pa 'jaM dbyangs rgyal mtshan<anchor xml:id="a6"/></rs>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7536">rma bya shAkya seng ge </rs><?oxy_comment_start comment="P5656"?><?oxy_comment_end?><anchor xml:id="a7"/>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">mchims namkha' grags</rs><?oxy_comment_start comment=" P1060 7th abbot of Snar thang"?><?oxy_comment_end?>|| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4051">rgyang ro byang chub 'bum</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P3644 13th century"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">mchims blo bzang grags pa</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P1298 12th abbot of Snar thang"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8355">bla ma bsod nams lhun grub</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="P5762"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5960">slob dpon grags pa rgya mtsho</rs><?oxy_comment_start comment="P1307"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8252">mkhan chen grub pa shes rab</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="14th abbot of Snar thang P1302"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8356">mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub</rs> <?oxy_comment_start comment="15th abbot of Snar thang P56 1399-1452"?><?oxy_comment_end?>| 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">rje brtsun namkha' blo gros<anchor xml:id="a8"/></rs>|
